items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: I paid off better than Larry do. Them boys play with me. I say, man, Larry don't pay off like you. You gotta wait till Larry gets the dookie chee, cash the check.

ctx.x: There's a couple more minutes on here. Yeah. Is there anything else you'd like to add about the different jobs you've had or the different trumpet players you've heard in your life in the early times? Well, I can say this.

I'm one of the best in the line of music. Get one of the best jobs in the line of music. I get the best. And I'm one of the best paying off in the music, the music ranking with all my mans. I'm one of your best paying off. And then boys, got a good word to say to pay off all my jobs. Some of them get their money for their starts on my job. That's how I run my business. You pay a man their money before you start playing music, you got to be alright. Yeah, that's right. You know what I'm saying? Yeah. See, and boys…
Now, how you do business like that?
